title: C-phase: Trace causality tracking — trace_id/parent_span_id + recursive-CTE call-tree endpoint + header protocol (user-adjudicated B->C->D order)

propositions: Span model: span_id == decision.id; single-parent chain; missing X-Parent-Span-ID -> NULL (root anchor for recursive CTE, NOT random UUID — random placeholder cannot be anchored; design ruling recorded in docs/trace_report.md §3.1)

Recursive CTE (storage.get_trace): root anchor parent_span_id IS NULL + UNION dedupe + max_depth=50 + max_nodes=500 guards; single-parent reachable cycles mathematically impossible (rewiring parent detaches from tree); guards target self-loops/deep chains (anchored: self-loop returns {R,A}, 60-deep truncated to 51 nodes)

Migration: _migrate() lossless 4-col expansion (tool_name/tool_lethality/trace_id/parent_span_id -> 12-col table); idx_trace index created AFTER _migrate() (legacy DBs have no trace_id column pre-ALTER; ordering fixed at runtime)

Header protocol: X-Trace-ID (root; UUID4 generated when missing) / X-Parent-Span-ID (parent decision id; NULL when missing) / X-Span-ID (response header = decision.id) injected at intercept entry; both DecisionRecord construction sites (malformed-tool DENY + main path)
Endpoint: GET /v1/trace/{trace_id} returns full call tree (depth-ordered) via asyncio.to_thread; 404 when trace unknown
B-phase linkage: tool_lethality as trace edge weight — per-node lethality visible for audit (test_lethality_as_edge_weight anchored)
Zero regression: 270/270 tests (250 baseline + 20 new), coverage 90.12% (>=60), GATE 1-7 exit 0; version v0.4.0
validation_scope.evidence: Full local run: pytest 270 passed; --cov 90.12%; check_test_quality, check_policy, policy_probe, meta_security_scanner, policy_sync, GATE 1-7 all exit 0 (full verification, no truncated output); e2e: two-request chain via X-Trace-ID roundtrip returns 2-node ordered call tree
